minutes.headline: Water district voters passed a voting-procedures bylaw (Article 3) with two floor amendments; the legal-bills transfer passed on reconsideration.
minutes.summary: The annual Lunenburg Water District meeting began with a long test of electronic voting clickers. Article 1 (paying prior-year legal bills from surplus revenue) failed its 9/10 vote, was reconsidered, and passed on the second vote. Article 2 (a pilot test on the Lancaster Avenue wells, funded from the cellular rental account) passed. Article 3, a citizen-petitioned voting-procedures bylaw, was amended twice from the floor, drew long debate and cautions from district counsel about conflicts with state law, and passed.

what_happened.line: Voters at the Lunenburg Water District meeting passed Article 3, a citizen-petitioned voting-procedures bylaw, after two floor amendments and a two-thirds vote as amended.
Article 1, a transfer from surplus revenue to pay prior-year legal bills, failed its 9/10 vote, was reconsidered after a ruling by the Moderator, and passed on the second vote.
Article 2, a transfer from the cellular rental account to fund a pilot test on the Lancaster Avenue wells, passed; officials said water rates are not affected.
District counsel cautioned that the proposed dollar threshold in Article 3 is stricter than state law and could put the operating budget to a two-thirds vote.
The legal invoices were late because they went to the Clerk Treasurer's spam folder; counsel said most of the costs related to the Howard Street 40B project.

why_it_matters: Article 3 changes how Water District votes are taken and sets a two-thirds requirement for large appropriations, which could shape future spending votes, including the operating budget, that district voters are asked to take.

Article 2 draws on the cellular rental account rather than the operating budget, so the wells pilot is not paid for through water rates, and officials expect the account to be replenished within two years.
watch_next: Whether the district and its counsel reconcile Article 3 with state law, given counsel's caution about the dollar threshold.
Follow-up by the Clerk Treasurer and counsel's billing department on the flagged legal invoices.
